scope: Post-hoc deterministic schema normalization of two public development examples. Not a benchmark score, independent validation or model ranking.

rules.review_item: Removed only if exactly equal to the assigned ID.

limitations: The adapter was designed after inspecting the two outputs; it was not preregistered.
Identical requests were served on different hardware and runtimes; latency is not a controlled model comparison.
Model agreement and exact citations do not establish factual or semantic correctness.
Two simple examples from one synthetic source family cannot establish general reliability.

propositions.text: No requester is permitted to approve their own purchase request.
propositions.label: supported
propositions.explanation: The source states that a requester "must never" perform this action, which confirms the statement that they are not permitted to do so.

citations.quote: A requester must never approve their own purchase request.

propositions.text: A requester is permitted to approve their own purchase request.
propositions.label: contradicted
propositions.explanation: The source explicitly states that a requester must never approve their own purchase request, which contradicts the statement that they are permitted to do so.
